## HAAS Alert and Nexar Join Forces to Advance High-Fidelity V2X Safety Communications for Automakers

May 28, 2025

SHARE

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a702d83c162df7b511fc26_facebook.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/nexar-advance-v2x-safety-communications-automakers#) [![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a702d838408bb4d10d71d2_linkedin.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/nexar-advance-v2x-safety-communications-automakers#) [![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a75bbb0bc783124efa7226_x-purple.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/nexar-advance-v2x-safety-communications-automakers#) [![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a75bd8cb84dbaa64766d7f_icon-share-purple.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/nexar-advance-v2x-safety-communications-automakers#)

_Tech-drive collaboration brings together expansive, real-time roadway hazard coverage and next-generation ADAS-grade validation to support OEM safety systems and connected vehicle intelligence._

**New York City, NY and Chicago, IL, May 28, 2025 —** HAAS Alert, the leader in real-time digital alerting for roadway safety through its Safety Cloud® platform and network, today announced a new initiative with Nexar, a leader in AI-powered mobility solutions. The collaboration is designed to address two of the most pressing challenges in the connected mobility ecosystem: ensuring time-critical roadway event coverage at scale and providing direct authentication of real-time roadway information for next-generation automotive systems.

Together, HAAS Alert and Nexar will deliver an unmatched level of quality and coverage in road safety data by fusing Safety Cloud’s real-time hazard and incident alerts with Nexar’s wide-scale data collection, change detection and validation capabilities. The collaboration enables an ecosystem where roadway hazards are not only detected and delivered to drivers and roadway managers in seconds — but also confirmed and enhanced through visual verification.

“This partnership with Nexar brings us closer to a truly intelligent transportation environment,” said Cory Hohs, CEO of HAAS Alert. “By combining our expansive real-time alerting network with Nexar’s video-driven validation, automakers and transportation system managers can connect to a uniquely reliable and high-quality V2X data stream for their safety, navigation, and roadway monitoring systems.”

“At Nexar, our mission has always been to see and understand the road like never before,” said Zach Greenberger, CEO of Nexar. “Teaming up with HAAS Alert allows us to extend our reach and enhance the freshness and accuracy of the roadway intelligence we provide to vehicles and drivers.”

Automotive manufacturers have long struggled to access scalable, high-quality roadway safety data for ADAS development, situational awareness, and in-vehicle driver assistance features. In March, Nexar announced a collaboration enhancing Nvidia’s autonomous solutions with Nexar’s real-world data. Now, the HAAS Alert–Nexar collaboration offers an end-to-end data stream of roadway events and conditions that is real-time, validated, and actionable, providing automakers with a uniquely powerful toolset to accelerate the future of connected and automated vehicle technology.

This joint effort is focused on two critical objectives:

- **Enhancing Quality:** The companies are working together to provide automakers with premium-grade ADAS-ready safety data, combining Safety Cloud’s verified digital alerts with Nexar’s image-based validation and AI insights. This ensures vehicle systems have the ground-truth clarity needed for advanced decision-making systems and next-generation driver assistance features.

- **Expanding Coverage:** By fusing Nexar’s real-time roadway vision feed with Safety Cloud’s live alerting infrastructure, the initiative creates a bi-directional ecosystem. Nexar-validated roadway events are distributed to motorists through Safety Cloud’s established in-car alerting network (via infotainment systems and mobile apps), while Safety Cloud’s digital alerts are simultaneously integrated into Nexar’s systems to inform their driver and vision intelligence network.

The result is a new benchmark in the connected transportation ecosystem: broader coverage of real-time, validated hazard data delivered directly to vehicles, increasing driver awareness and enabling automotive manufacturers to build smarter, safer mobility solutions.

**About HAAS Alert**

HAAS Alert's mission is to build lifesaving mobility solutions to make vehicles and roads safer and smarter. Our vision is a connected, collision-free world where everyone gets home safely. HAAS Alert’s platform Safety Cloud makes roads and communities safer by delivering digital alerts from emergency response, departments of transportation, municipal and private fleets, work zones, and connected infrastructure to millions of connected vehicles globally.

For more information, visit [www.haasalert.com](http://www.haasalert.com/)

**About Nexar**

Nexar turns cars into vision sensors to understand the world. Its platform powers vision-connected services and apps at scale, making new vision-based applications for better driving powered by a crowd-sourced vision feed. Using anonymous, aggregated data captured from this network, Nexar has developed a portfolio of vision-based data services for the autonomous vehicle industry and public and private sector partners to make roadways safer and more efficient.

For more information, visit [www.nexar-ai.com](https://www.nexar-ai.com/)
